name: Segmented control
$family: The single-select sliding-indicator switcher. Instances: View options (list/grid), Tab-bar's pill switcher, the chart view switch (Monthly / Year to date). Promoted from View options by Dave (2026-07-24) so the mechanism is one atom, not re-hand-rolled per consumer.
purpose: A single-select control: exactly one segment active at a time. One framing border wraps the track; the selected fill is a sliding indicator that animates between segments. Use for switching a presentation, scale, or range in place (not for navigation between destinations — that is Tabs).

props.name: shape
props.$note: Square (Mono). Every variant carries the 2px INSET track padding + a floating indicator (the pill's padding, applied to all — Dave 2026-07-24). The rounded PILL SHAPE is NOT a seg variant — reserved for a mobile Tab-bar alternative (deferred; see Tab-bar + _FUTURE-STATE mobile-variants).

props.name: content
props.$note: Label segments (text) or icon-only segments (.icons, 44px cells, accessible names required).

props.name: size
props.$note: Mini ramp (T-D15, RULED 2026-07-24): sm=12/500 · md=14/500 · lg=16/400 — bound in type.css (.t-cm-ctl-12/-14/-16 via .seg.sm/.md/.lg button). Visible heights 28/32/36; the invisible ::before target keeps every size at 44.

props.name: state
props.$note: Per-segment; the chosen option is 'selected' (aria-pressed=true), shown by the sliding fill + inverted label.

variants.name: label-square-md
variants.use: Default. Text segments, e.g. List / Grid / Table (14/500).

variants.name: sm
variants.use: Dense 12/500 control for chart / toolbar chrome; hit area still 44 via ::before.

variants.name: icons
variants.use: Icon-only segments (44px cells) for the same options.

tokens.selected-fill: secondary/background/default (the sliding .ind) — inverts, legible both modes
tokens.label-text: text/default; type = mini ramp .t-cm-ctl-12/-14/-16 (T-D15) bound per size via .seg.sm/.md/.lg button
tokens.border: form/border/default (one framing border, no inter-segment divider; 2px inset track)
tokens.hit-target: target/min (RULED — the invisible ::before target, default 44px; 9-anchor .hit-* matrix)
tokens.radius: border-radius/default (square, Mono). Rounded pill shape deferred to a mobile variant.
tokens.$finding: (2026-07-24) Promoted from View options. Selected fill = the inverting secondary/background/default sliding indicator (same as Tabs), not a per-segment pressed tint. Selection via aria-pressed, not colour alone (1.4.1).

accessibility.role: Single-select group (toggle-button group with aria-pressed, or radiogroup); only one segment active
accessibility.selected: Selected segment must not be conveyed by the sliding fill alone — expose aria-pressed/aria-checked (1.4.1)
accessibility.iconOnly: Icon-only segments need accessible names (e.g. 'List view', 'Grid view')
accessibility.targetArea: Every segment carries an invisible ::before target >= 44px (HSBC default; WCAG 2.5.5 AAA). The target anchors within the segment (9-point matrix, .hit-*) so a small visible control still meets 44 while staying aligned to neighbours
accessibility.motion: The slide + label colour change honour prefers-reduced-motion (become instant)

tokenValidation.against: Promoted from View options (components/view-options.meta.json), which passed token validation 2026-06-18 against the Figma native variable export; the sliding-indicator + inverting-fill binding is unchanged, generalised to the atom.
tokenValidation.result: PASS (inherited) — surfaces use tertiary/background/*; selected fill = secondary/background/default; border = form/border/default. --hit binds target/min (44, layout.json) — RULED + minted 2026-07-24. Text = mini ramp .t-cm-ctl-12/-14/-16 (T-D15, minted same day).

antiPatterns: Conveying the active segment by the sliding fill alone (add aria-pressed/checked)
Allowing multiple segments selected (it is single-select — use checkboxes/chips for multi)
Using it for navigation between destinations (that is Tabs / Tab-bar link semantics)
Shrinking the visible segment below 44 without the ::before hit target

family.$note: The single-select sliding-indicator switcher. Instances: View options (list/grid), Tab-bar's pill switcher, the chart view switch (Monthly / Year to date). Promoted from View options by Dave (2026-07-24) so the mechanism is one atom, not re-hand-rolled per consumer.
